ext_description.message: Paste a link, get a timestamped summary — YouTube, podcasts, articles. Free (your own Groq API key).

url_placeholder.message: YouTube, podcast RSS, Apple Podcasts, article…

status_done.message: Opened in a new tab — summarizing there now.

status_loading.message: Summarizing… this can take a while for long videos.

api_key_hint.message: Free, no card required — get one at console.groq.com.

error_no_result.message: No result ID in the URL.

error_result_not_found.message: This result was not found (it may have already been viewed, or the extension was reloaded).

footer_note.message: Works for YouTube, podcast RSS/Apple Podcasts feeds with a transcript tag, and article pages. Summarizing needs a free Groq API key (see Settings below) — no cost, no card.
